name: Movement USDCx
oneLiner: USDCx is Movement's native USDC-backed dollar issued 1:1 via Circle's xReserve smart contract, with CCTP/Gateway transfers to and from USDC on other chains.
collateral: 1:1 USDC held in a Circle-deployed xReserve smart contract; the underlying reserve is Circle USDC, whose backing is short-duration U.S. Treasuries and cash held by regulated custodians.
pegMechanism: Users mint USDCx on Movement by depositing USDC into Circle's xReserve smart contract, which issues USDCx 1:1; redemption burns USDCx and releases the underlying USDC back to the user. xReserve also enables 1:1 transfers between USDCx and USDC across supported chains via Circle CCTP and Gateway without third-party bridges.

reserves.name: Circle USDC held in xReserve smart contract

mintAuthority.summary: USDCx is Movement's USDC representation issued 1:1 through Circle's xReserve contract on the Movement Move VM. The xReserve module stores mint/burn/transfer refs in a Management resource and gates minting through an Attester+Admin role system (usdcx::Roles). The admin EOA 0x98ebb... controls roles, attesters, and upgrade; minting requires an attester-signed message — no permissionless free-mint path exists.

controls.label: Circle xReserve mint/redeem wrapper (USDCx 1:1 against locked USDC)
controls.evidence: Movement Aptos REST (mainnet.movementnetwork.xyz/v1): usdcx::Management resource at the token object stores mint_ref/burn_ref/transfer_ref/mutate_metadata_ref scoped to the token metadata — only the module logic can invoke them. usdcx::Roles resource stores admin = 0x98ebb7985c84a89972022edf391bdaa7d95f061d9742efb3703de368413431e1 and a list of 6 pausers including the admin. The module exposes mint(&signer, ...) gated on attester-signature check; no public free-mint exists. Module upgrade policy = 1 (upgradeable); upgrade controlled by ObjectCore.owner = 0x98ebb... (the same admin EOA).

controls.label: Circle xReserve admin EOA (0x98ebb...)
controls.evidence: Movement Aptos REST: usdcx::Roles.admin = 0x98ebb... The admin can add/remove attesters (required for minting), set pausers, and call transfer_admin. ObjectCore of the module deployer account (0x4989d...) shows owner = 0x98ebb..., confirming upgrade control as well. Auth key matches the address (normal EOA, not a multisig resource account).

controls.label: Inherited Circle USDC issuer mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC is issuer-minted by Circle (Ethereum MasterMinter + token owner/admin). USDCx's value and supply derive from USDC locked in xReserve, so it inherits USDC's concentrated-admin issuer posture.

review.evidence: Movement Aptos REST (mainnet.movementnetwork.xyz/v1) queried successfully. usdcx::Roles resource: admin = 0x98ebb7985c84a89972022edf391bdaa7d95f061d9742efb3703de368413431e1; usdcx::Management resource confirms mint_ref is module-scoped (no external free-mint). Module deployer ObjectCore.owner = 0x98ebb... (admin EOA). mint() requires attester-signed message gated by admin. No permissionless mint path confirmed. Module upgrade policy = 1 (upgradeable by admin EOA). The minting model is Circle-operated (attester+admin roles) consistent with xReserve/CCTP architecture.
